name: @delfrance/core
//temporal-polyfill: Literal, NOT catalog: — single-consumer (this package alone). Used by src/datetime for lossless ISO parsing: Date.parse truncates to milliseconds, so a provider's sub-millisecond digits were being discarded and then refilled with zeros by the ×1000. Temporal.Instant.from keeps them. Drop this dep and switch to the native global once the Functions runtime reaches nodejs26 AND the browser baseline ships Temporal — the call sites already speak the spec API, so it is an import deletion.
